Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
-< Johann Lionheart >- wrote:
> When playing a card that reduces a bleed, is this absolute or
> does it follow the standard rules for stealth / intercept?

Absolute.

You do not have to have intercept >= the current stealth in order to
play a reaction card (otherwise playing, say, Enhanced Senses would
be impossible).
